title: A typical day in MERIT: sign in, profiles, HL7 intake and manual entry
summary: Reset a forgotten password, switch between read-only and full profiles, import an HL7 file, match records, enter results and sign out.
scenes: Reset a forgotten password and sign in
Review data with a read-only profile
Switch to a full CRUD profile
Match imported records to existing patients
Manually enter results for existing patients
Add a new patient and enter new records

steps.say: Jordan starts the day on the sign-in screen, enters a user name and password, and realizes the password does not work.
onScreen: The user name or password is not right.

steps.say: Choose Forgot your password? to request a private reset link by email.
onScreen: Check your email · If MERIT has an account with that user name and an email address, we've sent it a link to reset the password. The link works once, for 20 minutes. · Email can take a minute or two to arrive. Check your junk or spam folder too. Only the newest link works. · No email? You may have mistyped the user name, or the account may have no email address. Contact your MERIT administrator. ·

steps.say: Open the reset link from email, verify with an authenticator code, and set a new passphrase.
actions: Types into Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (hidden)

steps.say: Return to sign in with the new password and complete the authenticator step.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Before making changes, open My profiles from the account menu and pick a read-only profile to review data safely.
actions: Selects “Profile: Master profile — Jordan Daily, switch profile or jurisdiction”

steps.say: With the read-only profile active, review Work queues and existing records. Write tools like Upload lab results stay hidden.
onScreen: Task · ⇅ · Quick view Queue · ⇅ · Person Case Due · ▲ · Assigned · Notify the prenatal care provider · Case PB-2026-000003 is for a pregnant person. · Quick view Prenatal provider notifications Okafor, Grace PB-2026-000003 Nov 11, 2026 · Overdue · Newborn testing follow-up · Arrange testing of the newborn after delivery (case PB-2026-000003). · Quick view Newborn testing Okafor, Grace PB-2026-0000

steps.say: Ready for daily intake work, open My profiles again and switch to the full access profile.
actions: Selects “Profile: Maryland review (read only) — Jordan Daily, switch profile or jurisdict”

steps.say: The header confirms the full profile is active, and Lab imports now offers Upload lab results and Match review.
onScreen: Lab imports · Upload lab results · Held records · Match review · Receipt quality

steps.say: Open Upload lab results, choose the HL7 profile for Chesapeake Reference Laboratory, and attach the HL7 file.
actions: Chooses “HL7 message from Chesapeake Reference Laboratory” for Sender and intake profile

steps.say: Choose Upload. MERIT queues the HL7 file and processes each message in the background.
onScreen: daily-hl7-training.hl7 · All rows held Chesapeake Reference Laboratory · Nov 26, 2026 1:58 PM · Jordan Daily · Received 2 · loaded 0 · held 2 · rejected 0

steps.say: Two imported rows need person matching. Open Match review under Lab imports.
First is Jim Carter. Date of birth and address agree with James Carter, and Jim is a nickname. Choose Same person to link it.
Next is Rosa Martines. The date of birth and address match Rosa Martinez with a one-letter typo. Choose Same person to link it.
Next, enter two paper lab reports for existing patients. Open People and search for Leo Rivera first.
Open Enter a result on Leo Rivera, fill in the venous lead result from the report, and save.
actions: Selects “Chesapeake Reference Laboratory 100 Research Drive, Columbia, CLIA 21D0712345”
onScreen: Result saved · Lead 4.1 ug/dL → canonical 4.1000 ug/dL · population Child

steps.say: Now search for Mia Rivera and enter her paper lead result the same way.
actions: Selects “Chesapeake Reference Laboratory 100 Research Drive, Columbia, CLIA 21D0712345”
onScreen: Result saved · Lead 2.4 ug/dL → canonical 2.4000 ug/dL · population Child

steps.say: Finally, a new patient has two paper reports. Search People first to confirm Tessa Holloway is not already in MERIT.
onScreen: Not the person you are looking for? Check the spelling and date of birth, then: · Add a person

steps.say: Choose Add a person. The name and date of birth carry over from the search. Select sex and save the new record.
onScreen: Tessa Holloway · Enter a result · Edit identity · Child Born Jun 15, 2022 (age 4) · Female · County: no current primary residence Contact only · Preferred language: Not recorded · Aliases, race and ethnicity, contact methods

steps.say: Choose Enter a result on the new person page to record her initial capillary screening result.
actions: Selects “Chesapeake Reference Laboratory 100 Research Drive, Columbia, CLIA 21D0712345”
onScreen: Result saved · Lead 4.8 ug/dL → canonical 4.8000 ug/dL · population Child

steps.say: Choose Enter another result to record her follow-up venous confirmation on the same patient record.
actions: Selects “Chesapeake Reference Laboratory 100 Research Drive, Columbia, CLIA 21D0712345”
onScreen: Thresholds and case outcome · Attached to open case PB-2026-000029; classification changed from suspect to confirmed. · Level Type Value This result · Case Case 3.5 ug/dL At or above · Reportable Reportable 0 ug/dL At or above · Child: one venous result at or above the level, by a confirming method. · The open case is upgraded from Suspect to Confirmed.

steps.say: At the end of the day, open the account menu in the header and choose Sign out to end the session cleanly.
actions: Selects “Profile: Maryland daily intake (full CRUD) — Jordan Daily, switch profile or jur”
